intro: This errand introduces Horde adventurers to aerial travel across Kalimdor by commissioning a wind rider from the Crossroads to Orgrimmar. Entrusted with Zargh's fresh cuts of meat, travelers land at the capital's Skytower to deliver the package directly to Innkeeper Gryshka.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For just a few coins I will have a wind rider bring you to Orgrimmar. When you get there, you can take Zargh's Meats to Gryshka. Her inn is in the Valley of Strength, not far from the Skytower, where my wind rider will drop you off.
Speak with me again when you are ready for the journey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Something smells good! You don't have raw meat on you, do you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, wonderful! Those are fine cuts! These are from Zargh, are they? That orc sure knows his way into a lady's heart...
Oh, I can't wait to cook it. But not too much! Meat is best served rare, don't you think?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
